discrepancies.title: OM 'net' yield 10.7% vs buyer's net 8.2%
discrepancies.why: The OM calls the yield net, but it deducts AED 118,700 of costs from AED 3,653,000, against AED 836,506 of Year-1 operating costs a buyer bears. The screen uses Year-1 NOI after the mandate's vacancy, collection loss, management fee, full opex and input VAT.

impact.basis: engine Year-1 NOI minus the net income the OM yield implies

discrepancies.analyst_action: Ask the broker for the costs behind the net yield; rebuild NOI from the operating statement and service-charge budget.

discrepancies.title: OM occupancy 99.0% vs rent roll 94.5%

sources.label: rent roll: 86 of 91 units let at 2026-10-31

discrepancies.why: The rent roll is unit-level and dated 2026-10-31; the OM figure (undated) is a headline the screen cannot trace to units. A gap of 4.5 points is about 4 units.

impact.basis: 4 units x average in-place rent AED 42,477: income the OM implies but the roll does not show (estimate)

discrepancies.analyst_action: Ask for the Ejari export and the vacancy list at the rent-roll date; reconcile the OM figure to unit numbers.

discrepancies.title: OM yield 10.7% is on asking price, before 6.2% acquisition costs

sources.label: acquisition costs (DLD 4%, broker, trustee, mortgage registration)

discrepancies.why: A buyer pays AED 2,055,195 on top of the price. On price plus costs the same income gives 8.2%.

impact.basis: OM income on price plus acquisition costs, minus the stated yield

discrepancies.analyst_action: Compare deals on yield on total cost; ask the broker to restate the yield on that basis.

notices.text: Tenants' security deposits of AED 189,750 transfer to the buyer and must be credited at closing.
Cheque profile: 34% of rent on 1-2 cheques, 32% of rent on 3-4 cheques, 35% of rent on 6 or more cheques. More cheques mean more collection risk and less post-dated cheque cover.

diligence_checklist.text: Title deed and DLD ownership search: freehold status, single title, and that the buyer is eligible to own the plot.
Building completion certificate (Dubai Municipality) for the as-built building.
Affection plan and permitted use: confirm residential use and the plot's permitted floors match the building.
Ejari export for every lease, reconciled to the rent roll unit by unit.
Civil Defence completion and annual fire-safety certificates, and ACP cladding compliance.
Building condition survey and capex plan for a building of this age (MEP, lifts, facade, waterproofing).
Retail leases: permitted use, trade licences and VAT treatment of shop rents.

rejected_model_findings.title: 'Passing rent' of AED 3,653,000 appears to include rent attributed to vacant units

evidence.quote: Passing rent from the current rent roll is AED 3,653,000 per annum.

rejected_model_findings.why: The OM calls AED 3,653,000 'passing' rent and uses it for the gross yield. The code-parsed rent roll shows in-place rent equal to potential rent, although 5 units are vacant. The floor table shows contract rent for floors with unlet units (floor 1 has 20 of 22 let, floor 3 has 19 of 22). The lease-expiry table lists only AED 3,480,000 of expiring rent in total, which is about AED 173,000 less than the passing figure. This suggests the headline figure includes rent assumed for vacant units. If so, current income and the yield built on it are overstated. The owner's statement shows lower actual rental income of AED 3,598,205, which supports that view.
rejected_model_findings.analyst_action: Ask the seller for the unit-level rent roll with each unit's status. Strip out any rent attributed to vacant units. Reconcile the in-place figure to the Ejari register and to the bank-statement collections behind the income statement.
rejected_model_findings.rejected_because: contradicted by the rent roll: OM income AED 3,653,000 equals in-place rent AED 3,653,000 within 2%

memo.markdown:
## Verdict
**Pursue**: the building passes every mandate test and the unlevered IRR clears the target, though not by much.

Buy at AED 34.8m [[uw.walk_away_price_aed]], exit at 9.0% [[uw.exit_yield]]. Asking of AED 33.0m [[deal.asking_price_aed]] is within our value. The assumption that most moves the walk-away price is the exit yield. Moving it 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] either way swings the price by AED 5.1m [[uw.walk_away_largest_swing_aed]]. The walk-away price and the returns rest on the firm's house view (reference rent path, exit yield, vacancy and downtime), not on market evidence for this building.

## The deal
- **What and where:** Almond Court, International City. 91 units [[om.unit_count]], completed 2015 [[deal.completion_year]], G+4, freehold single title.
- **Price:** AED 33.0m [[uw.price_aed]], which is AED 680 per sq ft [[uw.price_per_sqft_nsa]] on NSA and AED 550 per sq ft [[uw.price_per_sqft_bua]] on BUA.
- **Income:** in-place rent is AED 3.7m [[rr.in_place_rent_aed]] on direct leases with no master tenant. 86 units [[rr.let_units]] are let and 5 [[rr.vacant_units]] are vacant, so occupancy is 95% [[rr.occupancy_by_units]] by units and 94% [[rr.occupancy_by_area]] by area. Tenants pay the chiller.

## Returns
Unlevered, pre-tax:

| Metric | Result | Mandate |
|---|---|---|
| Unlevered IRR | 8.0% [[uw.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]] | 7.5% [[mandate.target_unlevered_irr.threshold]] |
| Equity multiple | 1.40x [[uw.unlevered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]] | 1.30x [[mandate.target_unlevered_equity_multiple.threshold]] |
| Going-in net yield on total cost | 8.2% [[uw.going_in_net_yield_on_cost]] | 6.0% [[mandate.min_going_in_net_yield_on_cost.threshold]] |
| Entry yield on price | 8.7% [[uw.entry_yield_on_price]] | none |
| Exit yield | 9.0% [[uw.exit_yield]] | none |

Year-1 NOI is AED 2.9m [[uw.noi_year1]]. Levered, secondary: IRR 8.6% [[uw.levered_irr_pre_tax]], multiple 1.45x [[uw.levered_equity_multiple_pre_tax]], Year-1 DSCR 1.79x [[uw.dscr_year1]].

The OM headlines 11% [[om.yield_stated]] net on asking price. On the buyer's basis (Year-1 NOI on price plus acquisition costs) it is 8.2% [[uw.om_yield.buyer_net_on_total_cost]]. That is below the OM figure: the buyer's yield falls short of the stated yield by 2.5 points [[uw.om_yield.gap_vs_stated]].

## What would make it fail
- **Exit yield.** With the exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] wider, unlevered IRR is 7.1% [[uw.sens.r+0.e+50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]], under the 7.5% [[mandate.target_unlevered_irr.threshold]] target.
- **Rent and exit together.** With market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] lower and the exit yield 50 bps [[uw.sens.exit_shift_step_bps]] wider, unlevered IRR is 6.1% [[uw.sens.r-5.e+50.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]]. Market rent 5% [[uw.sens.rent_shift_step]] lower at the base exit yield gives 7.0% [[uw.sens.r-5.e+0.unlevered_irr_pre_tax]], also under target.
- **Expiry cluster.** 27% [[uw.max_expiry_share_quarter]] of in-place rent, AED 996k [[uw.max_expiry_window_rent_aed]], expires between 30 April 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_start]] and 30 July 2027 [[uw.max_expiry_window_end]]. That is within the mandate limit but is the main re-letting exposure.
- **Thin income evidence.** The OM's stated opex failed verification and the OM gives no net income, so NOI rests on the screen's rebuild. No rent is let above the screen reference rent, so over-renting is not a risk here.

## Discrepancies
Lower-severity items are not discussed.

1. **OM "net" yield is gross and before acquisition costs (high).** The OM shows 10.7% [[disc.gross_yield_as_net.title]] net against the buyer's 8.2% [[disc.gross_yield_as_net.title]]. It deducts only AED 118,700 [[disc.gross_yield_as_net.why]] of costs from AED 3,653,000 [[disc.gross_yield_as_net.why]], while a buyer bears AED 836,506 [[disc.gross_yield_as_net.why]] of Year-1 operating costs. The yield is also struck on asking price, before acquisition costs of 6.2% [[uw.acquisition_costs_pct_of_price]]. These are one gap, counted once: the buyer's yield sits 2.5 points [[disc.yield_excludes_acquisition_costs.impact_ratio]] under the OM's. The screen used its own Year-1 NOI.
2. **Occupancy (medium).** The OM says 99% [[om.occupancy_stated]], undated and untraceable to units. The screen used the unit-level rent roll at 95% [[rr.occupancy_by_units]]. The estimated income the OM implies but the roll does not show is AED 170k [[disc.occupancy_mismatch.impact_aed]].

## Checks before diligence
- Ask the broker for the costs behind the "net" yield. Rebuild NOI from the operating statement and service-charge budget. Ask for the yield restated on total cost.
- Get the Ejari export and the vacancy list at the rent-roll date. Reconcile the OM occupancy to unit numbers.
- Tenant deposits of AED 190k [[rr.deposits_aed]] transfer to the buyer and must be credited at closing.
- Cheque profile: a large share of rent is on six or more cheques, which means more collection risk and less post-dated cheque cover.
- Title deed and DLD ownership search, including buyer eligibility.
- Dubai Municipality completion certificate.
- Affection plan and permitted use.
- Civil Defence certificates and cladding compliance.
- Condition survey and capex plan for the building's age.
- Retail leases: permitted use, trade licences and VAT treatment.

## Assumptions
The hold is 5 years [[uw.hold_years]] from 1 January 2027 [[uw.analysis_start]]. The exit yield is the higher of the area yield and the entry yield, plus 25 bps [[assume.exit_yield_expansion_bps]] of expansion and an age premium. Market rent falls 1.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year1]] in Year 1, then rises 2.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year3]] in Year 3 and 3.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year4]] in Year 4 and again 3.0% [[assume.rent_growth_year5]] in Year 5. Structural vacancy is 5.0% [[assume.structural_vacancy]], collection loss 1.0% [[assume.collection_loss]], renewal probability 70% [[assume.renewal_probability]] and management fee 5.0% [[assume.management_fee]] of income. Debt is capped at 45% [[assume.max_ltv]] LTV and sized at 1.40x [[assume.sizing_dscr]] DSCR. The rate is three-month EIBOR of 4.3% [[assume.eibor]] plus a 2.5% [[assume.margin]] margin, amortising over 15 years [[assume.amortisation_years]]. No operating-cost categories were filled from mandate defaults.
